{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# The number of unique patient IDs is the correct count of enrolled patients
# since each patient should only be counted once, even if they appear multiple times
unique_patients = trial_df['patient_id'].nunique()

# Confirm this is consistent with the total rows minus duplicates
# Each duplicate appears twice, so 48 duplicates account for 48 extra rows
# So total unique patients = total rows - number of duplicates
# 848 - 48 = 800

# Print the unique patient count
unique_patients"}
